infobox.usage: Unlocks the director's office on the third floor of the Beluga restaurant on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Beluga restaurant director key (Beluga) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the director’s office in the Beluga restaurant.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a possible location for the quest Beyond the Red Meat

sections.heading: Key location
sections.text:
- In Drawers
- In Jackets
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Doors to the director's office on the third floor of the Beluga restaurant at Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Behind The Lock
sections.text:
- 1x Locked Safe - There is currently no key for it in the game
- 1x PC block
- 1x Jacket
- 2x Drawer
- 1x Sports bag
- Loose loot (Valuables, Household materials, Provisions, Other items)
